# Support additional-damage pooling

- **Status:** ✅ Confirmed
- **Skills affected:** Chain Lightning
- **Mechanic tags:** damage-pool, supports
- **Last verified:** 2026-06-10 by Tyra
- **Backlog:** `CL-POOL-01` (see `docs/INGAME_VERIFICATION_BACKLOG.md`)

## Setup

Chain Lightning + one Magnificent + one Noble support, both carrying "+% additional damage for the supported skill". Vary their ranks.

## Raw data points

Confirmed multiplicative: two +20% universal additional lines → **×1.44** (not additive ×1.40).

## Derived / confirmed formula

Each "additional damage" line is its own ×(1 + x) factor; distinct lines **multiply**.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Re-confirm via Recount when convenient. See [support-rank-table](support-rank-table.md) for the per-rank magnitude (pending).

## Implementation (engine model)

`support_resolver.py::resolve_support_contributions` emits each additional line as a `dmg_additional` contribution whose `text` is tagged with a UNIQUE pooling identity (`|<item_id>|universal` or `|<item_id>|specific`). Offense's `affix_identity` then keys distinct lines separately, so `offense.py::_additional_product` gives each its own ×(1+x) factor while same-identity positives sum — no offense change needed. The universal rank line (Noble/Magnificent only, and only when the support's data carries `_UNIVERSAL_PHRASE`) reads `_RANK_TABLE`; the specific tier line reads `progression[tier]` via `_range_mid_fraction` (or a user `specific_rolls` override). Negative rolls (e.g. Merge) stay their own <1 factor. Verified by `test_support_resolver.py::test_web_merge_multiply_to_1466` (1.20×1.17×1.20×0.87) and `test_two_universals_multiply_not_add` (×1.44 not ×1.40).
